description: The REPL reads input, collects balanced brace blocks, and runs each source fragment.

steps.description: repl prints its prompt, reads lines, exits on end-of-input, interruption, or exit, and ignores empty input.
The REPL counts braces and continues with the secondary prompt until they balance.
run_source evaluates the collected input. A non-None result prints through the interpreter's value formatter.
Known Mini errors print to standard error. Other exceptions receive a separate unexpected-error message.

title: Read Mini in a REPL
